امتنعوا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَنَعُوا (imtanaʕū) /im.ta.na.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# اُمْتُنِعُوا (umtuniʕū) /um.tu.ni.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# اِمْتَنِعُوا (imtaniʕū) /im.ta.ni.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
